name: storage-reclaim
description: Disk cleanup for macOS that measures first, refuses to touch what a process or another session uses, and frees space in tiers you approve one by one.

lock_dir.title: Lock directory name
lock_dir.description: Name of a folder your sessions use to mark active work (for example .locks). Anything inside it is treated as in use. Leave empty if you have none.

worktree_suffix.title: Worktree folder suffix
worktree_suffix.description: Folders whose name ends with this text (for example -worktrees) hold other sessions' worktrees and are never deleted. Leave empty if you have none.
